metadata.name: Fallout Lane
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A tiny 1950s street on an atomic test range: a yellow two-storey house and a teal bungalow with a garage face each other across a lane blocked by a school bus and a truck. Spawn in your back yard, fight through the houses, the side alleys and the lawns, climb to the bungalow roof, shoot the mannequins to bits, and duck when the test siren goes off.

do.text: Welcome to Fallout Lane. The range is testing today: keep away from the windows.
ATTENTION: atomic test on the range in 30 seconds. This is not a drill.
Test in 10 seconds. Duck and cover!
The test is over. Every window on the street is gone.
